text:
sqlpipe moves data from Postgres to S3 as Parquet files. The reader process opens a cursor. It reads rows in fixed-size batches. Each batch keeps column names, data types, and row order from the query result. The reader sends each batch to the converter through an internal queue.

The converter maps Postgres types to Parquet types. It writes one row group for each batch. Each row group includes column chunks, statistics, and compression metadata. The uploader receives row groups and writes multipart objects to S3. It starts a multipart upload. It sends each part and records the returned part tag. If S3 returns a transient error, the uploader retries the part with backoff. When all parts finish, the uploader completes the object.
